item.title: IonQ and EPB Partner to Launch the Tennessee Quantum Communications Research Center
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ), the world’s leading quantum platform company, and EPB, Chattanooga’s energy and communications solutions company, today announced plans for the Tennessee Quantum Communications Research Center. This will be the first dedicated next generation quantum communication research and development (R&D) innovation lab directly connected to a real-world network. […]
